# ByteminusVoiceStudio

> Free, open-source local Bengali (Bangla) and English AI text-to-speech application, maintained by GitHub user thanvi47.

Website: https://thanvi47.github.io/ByteminusVoiceStudio/
Canonical source: https://github.com/thanvi47/ByteminusVoiceStudio

## Capabilities and limits

- Converts scripts to WAV/MP3 audio and estimated sentence-level SRT subtitles.
- Mithi provides ordinary Bengali neural speech; Kokoro provides US/UK English neural speech. Neither supports prompted emotional acting.
- English Parler and optional gated Bengali Indic Parler interpret descriptive delivery prompts. Exact acting is not guaranteed.
- Local inference after package/model installation; no paid hosted TTS API required. This documentation website does not host inference.
- CPU and supported CUDA/ROCm/XPU/MPS backends are probed. Windows DirectML is experimental and may fall back to CPU. GPU detection alone does not verify speech execution.
- App license: GPL-3.0-or-later. Optional OmniVoice cloning weights have noncommercial/community restrictions. Voice cloning requires the speaker's consent; similarity is not guaranteed.
- Windows x64, Apple Silicon macOS and glibc Linux installation paths. Native Intel macOS is unsupported by the pinned neural stack.
